rubrics.justification: Generally reasonable but somewhat overcalls image quality; notes possible partial collapse and thinning zona appropriately, yet ICM and TE are not clearly well-defined enough on this image alone to strongly support AA morphology.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, prior ectopic, and protocol with embryo quality and prognosis.

Logic is clear and conclusions mostly follow from the data; minor issue is leaning heavily on reported grading despite limited image clarity and discussing 3AA vs 4AA inconsistency without resolving it.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: single embryo transfer, luteal support, early ectopic surveillance, and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 30. Minor speculative points about fresh transfer receptivity are acceptable but not case-confirmed.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management, ectopic monitoring, tubal evaluation, metabolic optimization, and future cycle strategy with appropriate nuance.
